summary: axod keeps an authenticated outbound WebSocket to its account so remote clients can see and drive its sessions.
trigger: relay configured/linked, daemon start, or axo.relay.connect

steps.action: open WSS with the host credential (5 s connect timeout, ≤5 redirects)
authorize: account matches, host not revoked, credential verifier matches
register host with remote session snapshots (Pi panes and paths removed)
subscribe to local events including streams
loop: heartbeat every 10 s; forward at most one local event; read one incoming frame with a 20 ms read timeout
renew route lease (30 s) on register and heartbeat
on error, reconnect with backoff up to 30 s
